description: The Solana toolchain Mynt installs in build and verify sandboxes, and the versions its coding agents build against. One place for every pin: src/solana/toolchain.ts reads it, the weekly watcher (scripts/solana-toolchain-watch.mjs) rewrites it in a pull request, and test/solana-toolchain.test.js checks that the starter program, the vendored docs and the agents' instructions agree with it.
